notes: One logical two-leg monthly gold/silver turning-point persistence-reversion package. Q02 evaluates combined package PnL, paired costs, activity, and later Q09 correlation; neither component leg is a standalone strategy.

The EA selects thirteen synchronized completed month-end gold-minus-silver log ratios, rejects any pairwise ratio tie within 1e-12, counts eleven strict local triples, and fades the oldest-to-newest displacement only when the turning-point count is at most seven (equivalently 3*TP < 22).

The package targets equal absolute USD notionals, caps aggregate frozen-stop risk at one RISK_FIXED budget, and follows the validated QM5_12533 logical-basket host-symbol recipe with USD tester currency and the canonical 100000 deposit.
